name: @numra/angular
description: Angular service and standalone components for Numra. Calls your own backend — never holds an API key.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Publish the build, not the repo root: npm run build && npm publish ./dist. The leading ./ is required — a bare `npm publish dist` is a package SPEC, and npm will happily publish an unrelated registry package called dist. The root has no entry point: Angular components must be compiled ahead of time, so a root publish ships .ts that resolves to nothing and every import fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.' >&2 && exit 1
